name: Quick Mart PLC
listingStatus: Not listed. Offer for sale 05-30 October 2026; listing and commencement of trading on the NSE 12 November 2026.

ratios.label: EBITDA margin
ratios.note: EBITDA is the memorandum's reported figure on a POST-IFRS 16 basis (operating income plus depreciation and amortisation, lease interest left in net finance charges), so it is not comparable to a pre-IFRS 16 EBITDA.

ratios.label: Revenue growth
ratios.formula: (revenue this year - revenue last year) / revenue last year

ratios.label: Return on equity
ratios.note: Arithmetically real but flattered by a thin equity base: equity fell from KES 1.40bn (FY2021) to KES 1.06bn (FY2025) because dividends exceeded profits. Not a data error.

ratios.label: Debt to equity (bank borrowings / equity)

inputs.name: Bank borrowings
inputs.source: marker 152 (printed 150) indebtedness table; prose marker 105 (printed 103) 'bank borrowings ... KES 46.3m (31 Dec 2025)'

ratios.note: This is BANK borrowings only. The memorandum's real leverage is lease liabilities: net debt including lease liabilities was KES 7,272,728,000 at 30 Jun 2026 (front box, marker 32). Read this with the liabilities-to-equity and net-debt-to-equity rows below, never alone.

ratios.label: Liabilities to equity (total liabilities / equity)
ratios.note: Includes trade and other payables, so it is not debt alone; it shows how small the equity cushion is against total claims.

ratios.label: Net debt incl. lease liabilities to equity (30 Jun 2026)
ratios.formula: net debt (incl. lease liabilities) / total equity

inputs.name: Net debt incl. lease liabilities
inputs.source: marker 32-33 (printed 30-31), 'Net Debt (including lease liabilities) as at 30 June 2026'

ratios.note: Both inputs are as at 30 Jun 2026. Net debt is the memorandum's own front-box figure, which includes lease liabilities.

ratios.label: Interest cover
ratios.note: Net finance charges include IFRS 16 lease interest, so cover on this basis is lower than on bank interest alone.

ratios.label: Inventory days

inputs.name: Inventory
inputs.source: QUICKMART__balance.json, marker 134 (printed 132) net working capital table

ratios.crossCheck: memorandum prints inventory days 41 for FY2025 (marker 134 / printed 132)

ratios.label: Dividend payout ratio
ratios.note: Genuinely above 100% and not a data error: the memorandum's own payout table prints 109% FY2025, 104% FY2024 and 174% FY2023, because distributions exceeded profit.

ratios.label: Revenue per store
ratios.note: The memorandum prints KES 787,932 thousand (marker 129 / printed 127) as a derived quotient; it does not state whether the denominator is the closing 64 stores or an average count, so it is reproduced here on the closing count and will not match to the shilling.
ratios.crossCheck: memorandum prints KES 787,932 thousand for FY2025 (marker 129 / printed 127)

ratios.label: Operating cash flow margin
ratios.formula: net cash from operating activities / revenue
ratios.note: Computed without capex, so it is not affected by the withheld capital expenditure line.

ratios.label: Earnings per share (pro forma)
ratios.formula: pro forma earnings per ordinary share, post Capital Reorganisation
ratios.note: PRO FORMA: the memorandum states this on a post Capital Reorganisation basis assuming 4,000,000,000 ordinary shares (footnote 28, marker 119), not on the shares that existed in FY2025. The memorandum states NO projected EPS for FY2026 or FY2027.
ratios.crossCheck: memorandum prints pro forma EPS KES 0.38 for FY2025 (marker 119 / printed 117)

ratios.label: Net profit
ratios.formula: profit for the year, as filed

ratios.label: Gross margin (FY2026, projected)
ratios.projectedSide: both inputs are the memorandum's FY2026 forecast
ratios.note: A forecast covered only by an EY limited-assurance report under ISAE 3400, not a result.

ratios.label: EBITDA margin (FY2026, projected)
ratios.projectedSide: both inputs are the memorandum's FY2026 forecast

ratios.label: Net margin (FY2026, projected)

inputs.name: Projected net profit
inputs.source: marker 138 (printed 136), projected Profit for the year 31-Dec-26

ratios.projectedSide: both inputs are the memorandum's FY2026 forecast

ratios.label: Revenue growth (FY2026 projected vs FY2025 reported)
ratios.formula: (projected FY2026 revenue - reported FY2025 revenue) / reported FY2025 revenue
ratios.projectedSide: MIXED: the numerator is the memorandum's FY2026 forecast; the denominator is FY2025 reported revenue
ratios.note: The memorandum describes this as 'a projected growth rate of c.15% per annum' (marker 137 / printed 135).

ratios.label: Revenue growth (FY2027 projected vs FY2026 projected)
ratios.formula: (projected FY2027 revenue - projected FY2026 revenue) / projected FY2026 revenue
ratios.projectedSide: both inputs are the memorandum's forecasts

ratios.label: Return on equity (FY2026 projected profit on FY2025 reported equity)
ratios.formula: projected net profit / reported total equity

inputs.name: Projected net profit
inputs.source: marker 138 (printed 136), projected Profit for the year 31-Dec-26

ratios.projectedSide: MIXED: the numerator is the projected FY2026 profit; the denominator is FY2025 reported equity, because the memorandum prepared NO pro forma balance sheet (marker 40 / printed 38)
ratios.note: Equity is also moved by the offer and the dividend, so this is a rough projection, not a forecast the memorandum itself makes.

ratios.label: Dividend payout ratio (FY2026, projected)

inputs.name: Projected net profit
inputs.source: marker 138 (printed 136), projected Profit for the year 31-Dec-26

ratios.projectedSide: both inputs are the memorandum's FY2026 forecast
ratios.crossCheck: memorandum prints a 95.1% payout for FY2026 (marker 137 / printed 135)

ratios.label: Dividend per share (FY2026, projected)
ratios.projectedSide: the dividend is the memorandum's FY2026 forecast; the share count is the post-reorganisation 4,000,000,000
ratios.crossCheck: memorandum prints projected FY2026 DPS KES 0.50 (marker 33 / printed 31)

ratios.label: P/E at the offer price (memorandum's own, not a market multiple)
ratios.formula: offer price / projected adjusted earnings per share (memorandum's stated 12.9x)
ratios.derivedCrossCheck: offer price KES 7.50 / (adjusted net income 2,317,173,000 / 4,000,000,000 shares) = 12.95x, rounded to the memorandum's 12.9x
ratios.note: This is the memorandum's 'Implied FY 2026 Price / Adjusted Earnings'. It is NOT a market P/E: the shares have not traded. The market P/E is withheld (see the withheld rows).

ratios.label: Dividend yield at the offer price (memorandum's own, not a market yield)
ratios.formula: projected dividend per share / offer price (memorandum's stated 6.7%)
ratios.derivedCrossCheck: KES 0.50 / KES 7.50 = 6.67%, rounded to the memorandum's 6.7%
ratios.note: An offer-price yield, not a market yield. The market dividend yield is withheld (see the withheld rows).

flags.label: Thin, falling equity base
flags.detail: Total equity KES 1.06bn at FY2025, down from KES 1.40bn at FY2021, because dividends exceeded profits. ROE 142.9% on FY2025 is arithmetic on that thin base, not a data error.

flags.label: Distributions exceeded profit
flags.detail: Payout ratios above 100% from FY2023: 174% (FY2023), 104% (FY2024), 109% (FY2025), per the memorandum's own distributions table (marker 120 / printed 118).

flags.label: Leverage is lease liabilities, not bank debt
flags.detail: Bank borrowings KES 46.3m at 31 Dec 2025; net debt including lease liabilities KES 7,272,728,000 at 30 Jun 2026 (front box, marker 32). The debt-to-equity row on bank borrowings alone understates the leverage.
